description:
Advances: ancora.review

Findings: F8 (High, frontend H1). F28 (drift badge color, Medium) rides along only because it is the same rule block; F29/F60/F61 stay on ancora-d16. Individual report: 20260904-061300-frontend.md beside ~/vaults/rmbrs-vault/code_review/critical/ancora/2026-09-04/ancora-xla-post-ship-hardening/20260904-061300-consolidated.md.

Deliverable:
On this very branch, `mix spec.check` against main prints `spec.check result=pass` and exits 0 while `mix spec.review` from the same commit renders a red "fail" chip. lib/ancora/review.ex:117 derives the chip from findings_delta.change_verdict.clean? (introduced == [], no severity filter) instead of the gate report assemble/5 already holds; the gate does not block on info, clean? counts it, and this branch has seven introduced info findings. ancora.review.findings_inline is a must stating the chip reflects the gate outcome, and this branch edited that exact requirement.
Fix: take the verdict chip from the gate report the review already assembled, so chip == gate verdict by construction; add `.drift` to the bad-color badge rule at lib/ancora/review/html.ex:379 so the alarming badge is red again (F28, three lines, same file). The FindingsDelta severity-resolution half (Introduced/Pre-existing panels ignoring config severities and overrides) is F42 on ancora-d16 and is NOT in scope; say so in the record.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: test/ancora/review_test.exs, test/ancora/review_assets_test.exs, test/ancora/static/review_budget_test.exs
- Behaviors to demonstrate:
  1. A fixture with introduced info-only findings: the gate passes and the rendered artifact's chip reads pass. Mutation: derive the chip from clean? again; the test must fail. Also assert the converse: a fixture with an introduced error renders fail.
  2. A drift badge renders with the bad color class. Mutation: remove `.drift` from the rule; the test must fail (assert on the CSS rule text or the rendered class set, whichever the spec names).
- Spec edit required in-diff: ancora.review.findings_inline (or its scenario html_view_renders_green_chip) shall state the chip is the gate verdict of the same run, with a scenario where introduced findings are all info; if the scenario name promises "green chip", make the given/when/then concrete. Decision-record edit: affects entry on ancora.decision.review_artifact_contract.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: compile-graph-scoped checks only (`mix test --stale` or the named files) plus `mix spec.validate`; run `mix spec.check --base e18fa05` as a dev-loop check as soon as the spec edit exists, before either capped final-tier run.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`, the named test files, `mix format --check-formatted`, `mix deps.unlock --check-unused`, `mix spec.check --base e18fa05`, run-until-green. Full suite runs at the orchestrator's merge gate.
  - Verifier tier: `mix spec.check --base e18fa05` plus targeted selections; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test that fails under the named mutation; prove each ordered test both ways and report the numbers
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh: the substantive requirement or scenario edit named below lands in the same diff with its decision-record edit; never a Spec-Ack trailer; never weaken a must
  - Fixtures never call production functions (use test/support or System.cmd); under file-scoped derivation a stray call binds a subject
  - Grader scratch discipline applies to you too: work only in this worktree, address it by absolute path
- Call-site Integration: Review.build_with_context/3 -> assemble/5 -> Html.render; prove through `mix spec.review` on a fixture and reading the HTML back, as review_test already does.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/review/findings_delta.ex (F42, deferred), lib/ancora/gate.ex, lib/ancora/trailer.ex, lib/ancora/parser.ex, lib/ancora/verifier.ex, lib/ancora/git/**, lib/ancora/derive/**, lib/ancora/config.ex, lib/mix/tasks/**, priv/review/** vendored assets
Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/ancora/review.ex, lib/ancora/review/html.ex
- test/ancora/**, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md (substantive edit named above; never weakening a must)
- Any .spec/specs/<subject>.spec.md that `mix spec.check --base e18fa05` names in a derived/drift, derived/growth or derived/shrink finding caused by THIS ticket's own diff (binding-aware clause: derivation is file-scoped, so acknowledgment edits only, one substantive sentence describing what this ticket changed as that subject observes it, verified by execution; if the subject observes nothing, say so in the completion record and stop)
- .spec/decisions/** (every spec edit requires a decision-record edit in the same diff; write a real contract statement, never a hollow line)

Out of Scope (intent):
- No change to the artifact's size budget, to the vendored assets or their SHA pins, or to the dead-anchor set (F29 deferred). Do not rebase; base stays e18fa05.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes (`mix spec.check --base e18fa05` result=pass)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
